archetypes.name: checkpoint-parity
archetypes.rationale: Checkpoint-probe parity is the highest-risk behavior moved from Bash to Python.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/push.py and python/test_push.py for parity with the retired checkpoint probe. Focus on forked-target defaults, ROUTE emission, larch-log conflict resolution, mixed conflicts, empty-continue skip handling, and phantom probe gating. Check that failure modes preserve machine-readable stdout contracts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: migration-surface
archetypes.rationale: The cutover touches many docs, skills, allowlists, and Makefile shards.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the repository surface for stale references to deleted helpers and incorrect CLI argv replacements. Focus on skill fences, release and pause dev skills, Makefile harness shards, agent-lint and gitleaks allowlists, and migrated-scripts.tsv rows. Verify that any remaining legacy names are compatibility diagnostics or migrated-manifest history. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: step7a-harness
archetypes.rationale: The Step 7a offline harness was updated while replacing the checkpoint probe stub.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review skills/implement/scripts/test-step-7a.sh for faithful offline coverage after the Python checkpoint-probe cutover. Check that the CLI stubs model generator, diagrams upsert, rebase, and log flush behavior without reaching real external services. Verify docs/linting.md describes the current harness behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
